page.overview:
Who is Red-Buttock Baboon?

The is one of the four monkeys that defy the usual classification system for living beings.

The Red-Buttock Baboon has knowledge of yin and yang, understands human affairs, is adept at daily life, and can lengthen its own life to evade death
